newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower, hit by Dow and options expiry.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower, hit by Dow and options expiry.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index finished the week close to where it began after weakness on Wall Street and an unwinding of options positions sent it trundling lower on Friday.
The Dow's 92-point drop on Thursday got the FTSE's day off to a weak start and it headed lower after the 1030 GMT expiry of February derivatives contracts.

Modest Dow gains lifted the FTSE off its lows in the afternoon but it still ended 19.3 points lower at 4,336.8, not far from last Friday's close of 4,341.0. Dealers said the volume of trade had been disappointing.
